title.en: Reborn Hybrid CFW (alpha) for Nokia N95
title.ru: Reborn Hybrid CFW (alpha) для Nokia N95

not_a_flash.en: This is a SIS mod kit installed on the phone. It is not a Phoenix flash of a full firmware (Belle / Reborn N8).
not_a_flash.ru: Это SIS-набор модификаций, устанавливаемый на телефоне. Это не прошивка через Phoenix (Belle / Reborn N8).

card.author: symbuzzer

note.en: The author's pages give no permission to redistribute or mirror the file; they only ask for credit if the project is reused. SymPort therefore never downloads it: import the file you obtained from the author yourself.
note.ru: Страницы автора не разрешают распространять или зеркалировать файл; просят лишь указывать авторство при повторном использовании. Поэтому SymPort его не скачивает: импортируйте файл, полученный вами у автора.

compatibility.n95_8gb: no evidence; blocked until support evidence is recorded
compatibility.regional: RM-160 (NAM) and RM-245 (China) are not stated either way

prerequisites: The phone must be hacked: at least the installserver.exe patch installed (author)
warnings: Alpha release made by one person as a hobby (author)
Proceed at your own risk; you are responsible for all possible damage (author)
No uninstall procedure is published; the author's escape plan is formatting the device, which erases user data (author)
